firm_data.firm_description: Gregory Spektor & Associates P.C. is a New York-based law firm specializing in a wide variety of legal matters. They are known for providing high-quality legal representation in areas including automobile accident litigation, construction accident lawsuits, premise liability claims, and personal injury cases.
notable_facts: The firm has received awards such as Gold Client Champion and Avvo Client's Choice.
Gregory Spektor is admitted to practice in New York and New Jersey, as well as U.S. Southern and Eastern District Courts of New York.
